illustration.description: Flat vector-style illustration on a plain off-white background: a vertical blue measuring ruler with evenly spaced tick marks, standing on the left, next to a bold orange upward-pointing arrow with rounded corners and a subtle paper-like texture, placed to the right of the ruler at roughly its lower-middle height. Clean, minimal, simple flat colors, soft even lighting, no shadows, no text.

texts.font: Open Sans / Helvetica-style humanist sans-serif, all caps
